apps.name: Chum
apps.description: A Spotlight replacement for macOS. Press one hotkey and type: Chum searches everything at once — installed apps, window commands, clipboard history, snippets, and quick calculations — and acts on the top result. Window management ships with 27 ready-made commands, snippets expand system-wide, and a hyper key turns Caps Lock into ⌃⌥⇧⌘ for conflict-free hotkeys. A native, lightweight menu-bar app that works out of the box.

apps.name: Feedwire
apps.description: A lightweight, native RSS and Atom reader for macOS. Add feeds by URL — YouTube channels become feeds automatically — organise them into folders, and read in a built-in pane with unread-first sorting and bookmarks. Articles can be filtered by rule, and everything imports and exports as OPML. Built with Tauri, React, and Rust.

apps.name: Billy
apps.description: An ebook library manager for EPUB and PDF. A Calibre-style library without the bloat: import books or whole folders, keep them in a self-contained folder layout, and search with author, format, and year filters. Built with Tauri, React, and Rust.

apps.name: Splash
apps.description: A minimal comic reader for macOS. A fast, distraction-free reader for CBZ, CBR, and PDF comics — local-first, so your library, reading progress, and settings never leave your machine. Library folders become stack tiles, with favorites, read-later lists, and page, spread, and scroll modes. Native macOS app.

apps.name: Runningback
apps.description: See which of your projects have dev servers running. One Go binary detects every dev server on your machine, a terminal TUI shows them with their URLs, and a small macOS menu-bar app keeps a live count — without jumping into each project.

apps.name: Pho
apps.description: A photo import and management app. Detects camera cards, copies files into a dated folder library, and skips duplicates by hashing everything. Shots are grouped by filename stem (RAW + JPEG + sidecars are one shot) and reviewed one by one with keep/discard — sessions persist so you can resume later. Built with Tauri v2 on macOS.

smallProjects.name: Gridstone
smallProjects.description: A picross (nonogram) game built with Löve2D, with a 3D carving twist: Gridstone Carve lets you chisel sculptures out of iso-rendered blocks. No art assets — everything is drawn with rectangles, lines and text.

smallProjects.name: Blockera
smallProjects.description: A browser extension that blocks distracting sites with a dismissible blur overlay. Sites are organised into block groups, each with its own rules — temporary access, daily limits, delays, and active hours. Built with WXT, React, and TypeScript.

smallProjects.name: Eklipse
smallProjects.description: A browser extension for improving YouTube — hide the home feed, limit recommendations, disable autoplay, remove Shorts, and more. Strips away distractions and puts you back in control of your YouTube experience.

smallProjects.name: Hat Stack
smallProjects.description: A simple starter template based on Alpine.js, Tailwind and Handlebars.

smallProjects.name: Weeek
smallProjects.description: Small site that displays the week number.
